descripcion: Retrato hablado sobre fondo negro. La palabra manda; la imagen acompaña.
escena: A man of about fifty-five with short grey-flecked dark hair, a full soft salt-and-pepper beard that falls in soft irregular clumps, deep-set brown eyes with pronounced creases at the corners and a narrow mouth, wearing a charcoal grey wool sweater. Tight close-up: his face fills the frame from forehead to chin. A large soft diffused warm key light from the left wraps gently around his face, with soft gradual shadow on the right and no hard edges. He is seated against a plain matte black studio backdrop that fills the entire frame behind him. Static locked-off camera, fine film grain.
ambiente: A very quiet neutral room tone with no identifiable sounds, and the clear calm male dialogue spoken by the man.
musica: A single sustained low cello note held quietly and continuously beneath the dialogue, unchanging throughout.
notas: La barba se pide LLENA y en mechones blandos, y la luz GRANDE y difusa. Con 'close-cropped' y luz rasante salen pelos rectos y separados: la barba de cepillo que Steven llamo acartonada.
